43 different parts, 82 parts in one buoy and its sinker. (1): item 37 replaces item 36 on a green buoy.
Not seen in the view of the buoy: items 2, 6, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 19, 35, inside the float, canister, tail flange or topmark
(see the section ESP24-GA-02 and the details ESP24-GA-03), and item 37 (green buoy only).
Each part has its own STEP file, drawing ESP24-Pnn and Inventor build steps on the ESP 2024 page.
Third angle projection. Drawn from the CAD model with hidden line removal.
